prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.2 °C (68% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.8 °C (58% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.2 °C (50% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.82 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.4 bar (3% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
